narrative.northStar: KV-Cinema Sovereign — The Noir IMAX Screening Room
narrative.overview: KV-PhimAI is designed as an atmospheric, high-contrast private screening room for 9,220+ curated Vietnamese AI films (Veo, Sora, Seedance, Kling, Runway), bound to the sovereign KV-Tube media engine (https://u.khoavo.vndns.net) with zero third-party YouTube tracking embeds. Inspired by private IMAX projection rooms, Criterion Channel, and MUBI Dark, the interface pairs an Obsidian Projection Void (#0d0e14) and Elevated Screening Slate (#161822) with warm Tungsten Projection Gold (#ffd875) and Cinema Crimson (#e50914).
keyCharacteristics: Dedicated KV-Cinema Sovereign (Noir IMAX Screening Room) visual architecture with integrated header theater controls (Search /, AI Film Assistant, Vertical Swipe Feed, Watch Party & 6-Digit TV Pairing, and direct u.khoavo.vndns.net link).
High-contrast Vietnamese typography pairing Big Shoulders Display, Be Vietnam Pro, and JetBrains Mono with full diacritic fidelity.
Mandatory font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums across all ranks, Top 10 numerals, durations, weekly play counts, and category filter badges.
Complete browser-surface theming (::selection, custom dark scrollbars, :focus-visible tungsten gold rings, and caret colors).

rules.name: The Tinted-Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary and muted text never use untinted neutral gray; all secondary ink is tinted toward cool silver-indigo (#c4c8d9 and #989fb8) to harmonize with the #0d0e14 obsidian canvas.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings never carry an eyebrow or kicker label directly above them; metadata badges, ranks, and AI toolchain tags sit below the heading or inside a separate footer bar.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numeral Law
rules.body: Every rank (#9450), Top 10 numeral (01–10), view counter, and duration string applies font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns and reels align with mechanical precision.

rules.name: The Hairline-Boundary Rule
rules.body: Cards, callouts, and list items use uniform 1px solid borders tinted from the foreground or tungsten gold; thick colored side borders (border-left or border-right > 1px) are forbidden.

dos: Do route all video streams, thumbnails, and external watch links through https://u.khoavo.vndns.net and local /api/kvtube/* endpoints.
Do apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to all film ranks (#9450), Top 10 counters, durations, and filter badge counts.
Do use authored inline SVGs with consistent 1.75 stroke weight for all icons and controls.
Do place metadata badges, ranks, and AI model tags below headings or in card overlays rather than as eyebrow kickers above headings.
donts: Don't embed youtube.com or youtube-nocookie.com iframes or link directly to Google video servers anywhere in the interface.
Don't place small uppercase eyebrow/kicker labels directly above <h1>, <h2>, <h3>, or <h4> elements.
Don't use CSS gradient text (background-clip: text), thick colored side borders (border-left > 1px), or emoji/Unicode glyphs as UI icons.
